d: Handling file uploads, storing them securely, serving them efficiently, and processing media (images, videos, PDFs) is a common backend requirement. Object storage (S3/GCS), presigned URLs, and CDNs are the building blocks.

p: File Storage is a critical component of modern backend architecture. It focuses on optimizing performance, ensuring reliability, and scaling the system to handle increasing loads efficiently. Mastering this allows you to build enterprise-grade applications.

2. Evaluate open-source tools and industry standards.
3. Implement the pattern within your backend stack.
4. Monitor performance and adjust configurations as scale increases.
